sources.title: Approved Collective Investment Schemes
CMA Approves New Collective Investment Schemes and Sub-Funds

verification_events.note: CMA approved the ALA Capital CIS including KES and USD money market funds.
The approved scheme is represented in the current regulatory register.

sample_marketing_text: Invest in a recently approved Kenya shilling money market fund offering regulated pooled exposure to short-term instruments.
notes: A recent regulated product helps prevent 'newness' from becoming an automatic fraud proxy.
